title: Wren and the Tide
author: Ivo Underhill
blurb: Mara Blackwood, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
